title: Cloud Security: artifact scans
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for artifact scans.

## Basis

On-demand scan rate: On-demand artifact vulnerability scan; USD per GB.

Included monthly on-demand scan operations: Included on-demand scan operations per month; integer.

## Tier values

| Security tier | On-demand scan rate | Included monthly on-demand scan operations |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 0.073 | 50 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 0.073 | 100 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 0.073 | 250 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 0.073 | 500 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 0.073 | 1000 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 0.073 | 2500 |

## Tier comparison

For included monthly on-demand scan operations, the 50 Workloads tier lists 50 and the 2500 Workloads tier lists 2500.
